messages:
lee: SRE ping: 'Auto-fallback' is ambiguous in console. they flipped it and couldn't see what sub-options applied (mode/sample/triggers).
olga: Can we surface a single-line summary next to the toggle? SRE wants a readable audit row when policies change.
raj: Backend stores full JSON policy but UI currently shows only ON/OFF. we can emit a compact audit event on PUT /policy that contains user, env, mode, sample_pct, triggers. ops-bot: note: decision records are sampled; policy changes are full-event today.
lee: Minimal ask: when someone changes policy, UI shows: "Auto fallback ENABLED (mode=silent, sample=1%, triggers=[latency,5xx]) by <user>" as an audit line. that's it.
olga: UX: show summary pill: "Auto fallback • silent • 1% sample • triggers: latency, 5xx" with a tooltip for details. keep edit flow the same.
raj: I'll add the audit emitter and include req_id + actor. will link to event stream so the console can render the line immediately.
lee: Can we ship a dev-preview quick patch? SRE wants to validate before next demo.
olga: i'll prepare copy variants and post in #design in 30m.
raj: PR incoming, tests will assert audit line contains mode/sample/triggers. ops-bot: evt-9001 created (dev) to emit compact policy-change events.
lee: thanks. scope is small: pill UI + audit entry. revisit richer "why did I fallback" aggregated view later.
